description.zh: Coding Agent 完成一轮任务并发来最终结论，请简要总结并通知用户。
description.en: A coding agent completed a task turn and sent its final conclusion. Summarize it briefly and notify the user.

prompts.title: 通知总结提示词
prompts.content:
`coding-agent.completed` 表示某个 Coding Agent 已完成一轮任务，并发来最终结论。请用一两句话总结结论，调用 `pet_say` 通知用户；测试消息简短确认已收到即可。

`coding-agent.completed` means a Coding Agent has completed a task turn and sent its final conclusion. Summarize the conclusion in one or two sentences and notify the user with `pet_say`. For a test message, briefly confirm receipt.
